options.description: Open judge questions block all other tools until the agent asks them through the question tool. A bug in it could stall a turn, so it gets a way out: once asked, or when the tool is unavailable (a subagent or headless run), the gate opens.
options.label: Add the gate (Recommended)

options.description: The stop hook asks once per set of open questions. The agent can still carry on with other tools in between.
options.label: Land the follow-up as it is

options.description: Leave both until you have thought about it.
options.label: Hold everything on questions

payload.question: You asked whether the question tool can be forced. Nothing can make the agent call it, but plumb can close every other door until it does: while judge questions are open and unasked, deny all of the agent's tools except the question tool, and block the end of the turn. Shall I have this added to the questions follow-up before it lands?
